newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bank of Irl adds 15 pence after AIB soars.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Irl adds 15 pence after AIB soars.

text.p: Bank of Ireland's share price jumped 15 pence to 837 Irish pence following a lead by Allied Irish Banks whose share price rose 27 pence to 622 pence after reporting stronger-than-expected first half results.

"Bank of Ireland is up on the back of AIB's good results," one equity dealer said. "AIB had excellent figures and people assume that Bank is going to benefit similarly when it reports results later in the year."
AIB reported a rise of 20 percent in pre-tax profits to 242.2 million Irish pounds for the six months to June 30.
Analysts forecasts had ranged from 228 million to 232 million.
